title: C1 Milestone 5: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Extraordinario! Has superado el Milestone 5 del Nivel C1. Dominas los Mixed Conditionals, el Subjuntivo formal y el vocabulario de Finanzas Corporativas y Estrategia. ¡Tu nivel de inglés de negocios es ahora propio de la alta dirección!

parts.visual:
En este hito repasaremos las lecciones 21 a 24 del nivel C1: 
- Mixed Conditionals: If he had studied, he WOULD BE a lawyer now. / If I were faster, I WOULD HAVE FINISHED yesterday. 
- The Subjunctive Mood: It is essential that he BE present. / I recommend that she REVIEW it. / I wish he WERE here.
parts.audio: In this milestone we will review lessons 21 to 24 of the C1 level. We will test your knowledge of Mixed Conditionals, like: If he had studied, he WOULD BE a lawyer now. And the Subjunctive Mood, like: It is essential that he BE present, or I wish he WERE here.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos vocabulario avanzado de: 
- Investment & Capital Markets (Equity, IPO, dividend, portfolio, hedge fund, bull market, yield). 
- Corporate Strategy (Core competency, competitive advantage, blue ocean, economies of scale, paradigm shift). 
¡Este es el examen más sofisticado del bloque 5!
parts.audio: We will also evaluate advanced vocabulary from Investment and Capital Markets, including terms like equity, I P O, dividend, portfolio, hedge fund, bull market, and yield. And Corporate Strategy terms like core competency, competitive advantage, blue ocean, economies of scale, and paradigm shift. This is the most sophisticated test of Block 5!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este examen integral C1.

questions.question: If we had launched the product earlier, we ____ the market leaders now. (Mixed conditional).
questions.explanation: Causa pasada → efecto presente. WOULD BE.

questions.question: It is crucial that the board ____ the new budget immediately. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Subjuntivo presente: sin -s. The board APPROVE.

questions.question: The founders own 40% of the company's ____. (Capital/propiedad).
Our excellent customer service is our main competitive ____. (Ventaja).
If I were more organized, I ____ the report last week. (Mixed conditional).
questions.explanation: Condición presente (were) → resultado pasado. WOULD HAVE finished.

questions.question: The lawyer insists that the contract ____ signed by both parties. (Subjuntivo pasivo).
questions.explanation: Pasiva subjuntiva: that it BE signed.

questions.question: Instead of competing on price, they found a ____ ocean and created a new market.
The private company raised $1 billion in its highly anticipated ____. (Oferta Pública Inicial).
If they ____ that risky investment, they wouldn't be bankrupt today. (Mixed conditional).
I wish the negotiations ____ going better. (Subjuntivo - wish).
A private fund that uses aggressive, high-risk strategies is a ____ fund. (Fondo de cobertura).
Design and user experience are Apple's ____ competency. (Competencia central).
If the CEO ____ more decisive, she would have fired him yesterday. (Mixed conditional).
questions.explanation: Condición presente (were) → resultado pasado (would have fired).

questions.question: I recommend that the CFO ____ the financial statements personally. (Subjuntivo).
The board approved a special $2 per share ____. (Dividendo).
By producing millions of units, they achieved massive economies of ____. (Escala).
He acts as if he ____ the CEO of the company. (As if + subjuntivo).
To manage risk, you should diversify your investment ____. (Cartera).
The lack of microchips caused a massive ____ in our production line. (Cuello de botella).
The company's ____ statement defines its primary purpose and why it exists. (Misión).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra o estructura correcta.

questions.question: If he had studied, he ____ be rich now. (Mixed - would)
It is vital that he ____ present. (Subjuntivo - be)
If I ____ the boss, I'd have fired him. (Condicional subj - were)
I suggest that she ____ it. (Subjuntivo - review)
Company ____. (Capital con E)
An ____. (Oferta pública inicial, siglas)
Core ____. (Competencia central con C)
Competitive ____. (Ventaja con A)
Economies of ____. (Escala con S)
A ____ fund. (Fondo de cobertura con H)

pairs.source: If he had studied, he WOULD BE a lawyer.
If I WERE faster, I WOULD HAVE won.
It is essential that he BE present.
I wish he WERE more flexible.
